description: List direct device links (Direktverknüpfungen) — sender→receiver channel pairings that operate independently of the CCU (e.g. a wall switch directly driving a lamp, or thermostats linked to a FALMOT). Read-only. Optionally filter to links involving a specific device or channel address.

address.description: Device or channel address to filter by (e.g. '000A1BE9A71F15' or '000A1BE9A71F15:1')

target.description: CCU target to read from (default: active). See list_ccu_targets.

name: list_links
title: List Direct Device Links
